bagPolicy.summary: Raymond James Stadium enforces a No Bag policy for all events, allowing only one clutch purse no larger than 4.5” by 6.5”. Bags larger than this size are not permitted, even if clear.
allowed: one clutch purse no larger than 4.5” x 6.5”
prohibited: Aerosol or spray bottles of sunscreen
Any item that could be used as a missile
Cameras longer than 12 inches or with detachable lenses
Unmanned Aircraft Systems & Radio Controlled Model Aircraft/Drones
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking at Raymond James Stadium is cashless and contactless, with prices varying by event. Parking is first-come, first-served, and advance purchase is recommended. RV and camper parking is available in designated lots.

rideshare.note: Rideshare pickup and drop-off is at Steinbrenner Field. Check the event page because high-volume concerts may use a different pickup area.

concessions.note: Raymond James Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including local specialties and chef-driven creations. Highlights include $6 domestic beer cans, a $20 gameday combo, and the Tampa Chef Series featuring local culinary offerings. The venue emphasizes locally sourced and sustainable ingredients.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair and accessible seating is available throughout the stadium. Guests with disabilities who have general tickets use the entrances at the Ford Gate and Suzuki Marine Gate, and club and suite holders have elevators just inside their entrance. Ask for the Accessibility Guide at any Guest Services booth.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted unless in the event of a medical emergency.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will call is in the south plaza between Gates C and D, beside the Stadium Office. Bring identification matching the name on the tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Check your ticket for where to enter. General admission gates are Ford Gate, Gate B, Suzuki Marine Gate, and Fifth Third Bank Gate. Club and suite ticket holders use the Hyundai West Club or East Club entrances, and accessible entrances are near the ramps at the Ford and Suzuki Marine gates.
